EnumTypeDef.name: StaticWorkloadType
EnumTypeDef.comment: Enum representing defined types of static workloads.

elements.comment: represents generic network devices which can not be bootstrapped with an identity due to limitations
represents a public cloud load balancer ( for ingress to public cloud )
represents a public cloud NAT gateway ( for egress from public cloud )
Appliance present outside of enterprise deployment locations. For SaaS / Third Party / Vendor use cases
represents a virtual ip backed by a load balancer
represents a cloud managed service or endpoint
represents subnet for a given service, would be almost always a RFC1918 cidr

resources.comment: This API endpoint facilitates the creation or update of a transport policy for a specified domain and service. It is designed exclusively for the purpose of creating or updating transport policies, and does not support mixed-case scenarios. Once a transport policy is established, the destination service, protocol, and both source and destination ports become non-editable. To modify any of these fields, it is necessary to create a new policy and delete the old one.

The principal is taken from the caller's identity and the time is stamped by the server.
